| Category = Fish recipes

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] [[Cookbook:Cod|cod]], [[Cookbook:Haddock|haddock]], or [[Cookbook:Tilapia|tilapia]] fillets, cut in half
* [[Cookbook:Cornmeal|Cornmeal]] as needed
* Freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]], as needed
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* 2 tbsp smoked [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Oil]] for [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep frying]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine all dry seasonings. Set aside.
#Dip fish in lemon juice, season with seasoning mixture, then [[Cookbook:Dredging|dredge]] in cornmeal.
#Heat oil to 375°F. [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] fish in batches for 3 minutes. Drain on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling rack]].
#Cut into one strip. If inside is underdone, finish in a 350°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]], not in the oil. Serve.
